images.title: Generic PC keyboard, 104 keys ANSI
images.author: unreal-ng
images.terms: vector drawing from measured dimensions; photos used as references only, nothing traced

references.what: the key pitch 19.05 mm and the 104-key ANSI layout: the main block of 15 units, the navigation block and the keypad a quarter unit apart, the key widths of the bottom rows
the cap: about 18 mm at the skirt, the top about 5 mm narrower and set back on a sculpted profile
